# Third-party agent marks

The logos in this folder belong to their owners. They are shown on the
landing page of keepthewhy.com in one strip, in one color, to say which
coding agents Keep the Why can be installed on — the same use
[skills.sh](https://www.skills.sh/) makes of them under "Available for
these agents". Nothing here claims endorsement by or affiliation with any
of these projects or companies.

Origin, fetched 2026-10-07:

- All files except `pi.svg`: the agent strip on https://www.skills.sh/
  (`/agents/<name>.svg`), the twenty agents listed there at the time. Keep
  the Why installs through the skills CLI, so that list is the one this
  site inherits.
- `pi.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/?q=pi), CC0, the mark of
  [Pi](https://pi.dev/).

The files are stored as received, byte for byte. The page recolors them at
render time with a CSS mask (`docs/assets/extra.css`, `.ktw-agents__logo`),
which keeps the shape and drops the tile; the files themselves are not
edited.

If you own one of these marks and want it removed or shown differently,
open an issue at https://github.com/oliver-zehentleitner/keep-the-why/issues
or write to the address on https://keepthewhy.com/imprint/ — it will be
done file by file, no questions asked.
